title: VoIP Calls (live listening · SIP · RTP)
description: voip-agent on trunk nodes (in-memory capture, no pcap on disk) + voip-gateway call console. Meydan my03 ens19 and Dubai South ds02 ens19 = du trunks.

list.name: console
list.label: Console URL
list.description: Where voip-gateway is served: /voip on the production Grafana domain (NPM), http://localhost:8090/voip for a local test.

options.content:
⬇ Download PCAP for "${search}" in this time range  ·  🎧 Open the console in its own tab
Listen live (Admin), replay or download PCAP (Admin, Editor) right in the console below. For the PCAP link, type the number in Search and pick the time range first. Audio and pcaps come from the RAM buffer on the trunk node, nothing is stored on disk; every listen and download is audited (bottom of this dashboard).

panels.title: Replay window
panels.description: How far back calls can still be replayed: age of the oldest RTP packet in the RAM buffer.

panels.title: Live calls (click a row to listen)
panels.description: Calls in progress on the trunk. Clicking opens the call console; live listening needs the Grafana Admin role.

panels.title: Recent calls (click to replay while still in the RAM buffer)
panels.description: Every finished call on the trunk (answered calls appear at BYE). Replay needs Editor or Admin and only works while the audio is still in the agent's RAM buffer (see 'Replay window').

targets.expr: {job="voip",cluster=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$server",kind="call"} | json | from=~".*${search:regex}.*" or to=~".*${search:regex}.*" or call_id=~".*${search:regex}.*"

panels.title: SIP rate by method
panels.description: INVITE, BYE, CANCEL… per second (both directions).

panels.title: RTP packet loss %
panels.description: in = far end to us, out = us to far end.

panels.title: Listening audit (who listened to what)
panels.description: Every replay, live session and PCAP download through the call console, including denied attempts. Kept 14 days (Loki default).
